0x0009A3.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A9C.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B16.en: 「Is this... the end, is it not...?」

0x000BC5.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000BFD.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, sheesh!」

0x000CC6.en: 「Tch! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000D01.en: 「No way I flop here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000D55.en: 「I blew it...!@　Guess I've got to bail...」

0x000DC9.en: 「Guh! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000E3F.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000EA6.en: 「This is it... the rest is up to you.」

0x000ED8.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000F52.en: 「No good, we've taken too many losses... Retreating!」

0x000F9F.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FDD.en: 「Kyaa! I leave the rest to you!」

0x001024.en: 「For the Granzon to be... shot down...」

0x0010CF.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00114E.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x001186.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x0011C7.en: 「Well, ain't that somethin'. They got me good!」

0x00120B.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x001278.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012BF.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x0012F4.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0013E0.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@ I'm still green...!」

0x00142E.en: 「No good, I can't hold out! Retreating!」

0x0014E9.en: 「Sorry, I leave the rest to you!」

0x001518.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001556.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x001585.en: 「I can't go on any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x001610.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back here...!」

0x00168D.en: 「Tch...! I can't hold on after all...!」

0x001776.en: 「Ejecting...@ Ngh...! I can't even keep my composure...」

0x001834.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A46.en: 「No good, they went and got me.」

0x001AD2.en: 「Multiple Ruina units confirmed ahead of the ship!」

0x001B03.en: 「All guns, prepare to fire.@ We don't know what may happen, so proceed with caution.@ Stand by until ordered.」

0x001B88.en: 「...Captain, it seems this is the deepest point.」

0x001BCE.en: 「To think a space this vast lay@ beneath the opening we came through...」

0x001C40.en: 「There are many subglacial lakes under the Antarctic ice sheet.@ The largest nearby is Lake Vostok,@ 250 km long and 40 km wide...」

0x001D09.en: 「This is an exception among exceptions, of course,@ but something existing beneath Antarctic ice@ isn't so unusual in itself.」

0x001DB4.en: 「I doubt it's quite that simple...@ but are we to take it that this is the heart@ of the Fabula Foris?」

0x001E5F.en: 「Yes. And what lies ahead@ is the Fabula Foris itself, but...」

0x001ECD.en: 「...It's almost like some kind of gateway...@ And that light...?」

0x001F32.en: 「I've never seen a structure like that either.@ The luminescence included.」

0x001FB0.en: 「I'd guess it emerged from within the ruins@ after the Fabula Foris began to move.」

0x002036.en: 「You mean... this is the true form of the Fabula Foris?」

0x00207C.en: 「Either it existed beneath the structure all along,@ or a seal broke and it took that shape...」

0x0020FC.en: 「Either way, if even the Doctor didn't foresee this...」

0x002189.en: 「...Cliff, was that true just now? You said@ you'd never seen that structure before...」

0x002200.en: 「Yeah. If I'd known, I'd have told you beforehand.@ It may be something the Professor didn't foresee either.」

0x002280.en: 「Laki, Wen, is it the same for you two?」

0x0022C7.en: 「It's my first time seeing it too.@ But the negative wave is flowing in there...@ The 'King of Ruin' is probably inside.」

0x002392.en: （So it exists in this world too...）

0x0023D2.en: 「Huh, I feel like I've seen that somewhere...」

0x002473.en: 「It's just a vague feeling, I've got no proof...」

0x0024B3.en: 「B-but this is our first time seeing the@ Fabula Foris itself, me and big bro too...@ so how could we...!?」

0x002555.en: 「It's not just Ryusei and the others, I feel it too...」

0x0025A8.en: 「Hold on, hold on.@ Deja vu or not, if this many people start saying it,@ it can't just be coincidence, can it?」

0x00267B.en: 「Jab or straight, I don't know which,@ but I've seen something like that before.@ Right, Axel?」

0x00271A.en: 「That's right.@ In the world on the 'other side' we were thrown into.」

0x0027A8.en: 「Yeah.@ A gate connecting different space-times, different worlds...@ Over there, they called it the 'Cross Gate.'」

0x002857.en: 「Thanks to that thing, I saw a world where all kinds@ of things mixed together and fought.」

0x0028ED.en: 「Why would something like that be in Antarctica...!?」

0x002927.en: 「That's what I'd like to know myself.」

0x002964.en: 「Could it be that thing's connected to@ the world you two went to?」

0x0029CC.en: 「Don't tell me the Ruina came from there too...!?」

0x002A06.en: 「No.@ I never saw anything like the Ruina in that world.」

0x002A5F.en: 「I don't know where the Cross Gate came from,@ but it seems to have existed in various worlds.@ In other words, there's more than one.」

0x002AFE.en: 「...Roar, what about you?@ You were asleep in that world, so@ it might be your first time seeing it.」

0x002B8E.en: 「No. I've seen it in a world different from this one.@ What Axel says is correct.」

0x002C11.en: 「Then do you know who made the Cross Gate,@ and what for?」

0x002C73.en: 「Sorry, I don't know the details either.@ But in worlds where the Cross Gate existed,@ calamity poured through, and fierce wars broke out.」

0x002D30.en: 「Like how the Ruina came out, you mean...」

0x002D6A.en: （The Cross Gate... it matches a word within my@ 'false memories.' I see, so that's how it is...@ Coming all this way was worth it.）

0x002E2D.en: （The reason the boundaries around Earth are blurring...@ the reason so many phenomena converge and foreign things intrude...）

0x002EB9.en: （It isn't only the Granzon's black box.@ The fact that this existed here@ is surely a large part of it too.）

0x002F73.en: 「...Then how do you explain the sense of@ familiarity Ensign Kusuha, Ensign Ryusei@ and the others felt?」

0x003018.en: 「Could it be memories of a past life, that sort of thing?」

0x00307D.en: 「How do I put it, I just thought so at a glance...@ I've got no proof.」

0x0030DF.en: 「It just feels like I remember it somehow,@ nothing more than that...」

0x003175.en: 「But that's the only way I can put it.」

0x0031AF.en: 「Since multiple people felt that way,@ shouldn't we assume there's some basis for it?」

0x00322F.en: 「Right... the one condition that stands out@ is being a Psychodriver, maybe...?」

0x0032EA.en: 「No deja vu, but the words 'Cross Gate'@ feel familiar somehow...」

0x003377.en: 「Ing, could it have something to do with@ the memories you lost...?」

0x0033C0.en: 「I don't know... but the Cross Gate doesn't@ stir up any images for me.」

0x00342E.en: 「So you're not much different@ from Ryusei and the rest, then?」

0x003481.en: 「...Right.@ Though in my case, I might be confusing it with something else...」

0x0034D4.en: （There are others besides me who hold@ false memories about the Cross Gate...）

0x003539.en: （Even so, why do we have them...@ and why have those with them gathered here...@ It can't be dismissed as mere coincidence.）

0x0035F0.en: （Is there some connection between me and that thing...?）

0x003633.en: (What I can't grasp is that Ing, one of the Machinery Children, knew the words 'Cross Gate'...)

0x0036CE.en: (What if it isn't a false memory,@　but one that was given to me...?)

0x003724.en: (Either way, causality seems to be converging.@　I must see this event through@　to its conclusion.)

0x0037B0.en: 「Mekibos, what about you?@　Does Zovorg have any record of that thing?」

0x003840.en: 「So Father built Fabula Foris without knowing@　about the Cross Gate... and that gate leads@　to the world where the Ruina existed...?」

0x0038FA.en: 「And that's where the 'King of Ruin' comes from?」
